About us

Experts of our company have experience of more than 20 years in the field of the used car market. We will hand pick the vehicle, check the mechanical performance, the state of the paint and the driving experience for you.

Our specialists have more than 20 years of extensive experience in the automotive industry in Russia and Cyprus and are happy to advise you on all of your questions. If you really want to buy a real car, with all the mechanical and legal guarantees, welcome to RealCar C.R.B. Ltd.

The warranty applies to cars imported by us from England and Japan, after the client’s confirmation. There is no warranty on secondary-sale vehicles.
